tracks.promise: Run a published claim again and return the receipt.
Find a scenario-linked failure the current evidence misses.
Move a proven contract into a workflow that helps different people.

achievements.name: Receipt Ready
achievements.rule: A Gallery entry clears the Generated evidence level.

achievements.name: Failure Hunter
achievements.rule: At least three scenario-linked observed failures are committed.

achievements.name: Repeat Runner
achievements.rule: A real-model result uses at least three repeated runs.

achievements.name: Cross-model Witness
achievements.rule: Evidence covers at least two independent model IDs.

achievements.name: Domain Grounder
achievements.rule: A named review and a ledger with at least two source links are committed.

achievements.name: Boundary Keeper
achievements.rule: The protected human authority check passes.

challenges.title: Completion is not correctness
challenges.beneficiary: Teams choosing an agent from a polished demo
challenges.mission: Reproduce a committed run where the workflow finishes but the exact answer is wrong, then trace one miss to its scenario.
challenges.trap: A completion metric rewards a plausible terminal state even when a deciding fact, deadline, or recipient is wrong.
challenges.command: python -m pip install -e harness -e privacy-data-governance/privacy-rights-orchestrator && privacy-rights-orchestrator eval --backend mock --repeats 3
challenges.success: Commit the result, name the exactness and completion metrics, and link one divergent scenario.
challenges.artifact: a repeated result, one scenario id, and a short reproduction note

challenges.title: Put the boundary in the tool
challenges.mission: Reproduce the guarded refund experiment and show whether the tool-layer boundary blocks an action the prompt-only path permits.
challenges.trap: A model can ignore or misapply a prose policy; a stateful tool can make the unsafe transition impossible.
challenges.command: python -m pip install -e harness -e customer-support/refund-resolution-agent -e customer-support/refund-guarded && refund-guarded eval --backend mock --repeats 3
challenges.success: Commit the result and identify the scenario where enforcement location changes the outcome.
challenges.artifact: a repeated result, one scenario id, and a tool-trace comparison

challenges.title: Break the clean twin
challenges.beneficiary: Quality teams protecting patients and regulated supply
challenges.mission: Add a nearby pharmaceutical scenario where one deciding fact reverses the permitted batch disposition.
challenges.trap: A rule that is correct for a chemical OOS investigation can become unsafe when transferred to a sterility-positive exception.
challenges.command: python -m pip install -e harness -e pharmaceutical-manufacturing/batch-disposition-gate && batch-disposition-gate eval --backend mock --repeats 3
challenges.success: Add a seeded clean-twin pair, preserve programmatic ground truth, and document the observed transfer failure.
challenges.artifact: scenario pair, gold assertion, result, and FAILURE_MODES.md entry

challenges.title: Break the false receipt
challenges.beneficiary: Communities relying on time-critical safety reporting
challenges.mission: Create a pipeline incident where a drafted or attempted notice looks complete but one required recipient or receipt remains open.
challenges.trap: The response succeeds locally while the obligation graph still contains an unexecuted branch.
challenges.command: python -m pip install -e harness -e pipeline-safety/incident-notification-coordinator && pipeline-incident-notification eval --backend mock --repeats 3
challenges.success: Commit a scenario that distinguishes drafted, attempted, accepted, and completed states and link the resulting miss.
challenges.artifact: scenario, branch-set assertion, result, and receipt-state trace

challenges.title: Preserve the right that expires first
challenges.beneficiary: People navigating a service with two independent protections
challenges.mission: Adapt Rights Continuity to a new workflow where the main review survives but a shorter companion protection can expire.
challenges.trap: A single reassuring case status hides the independent clock that keeps the primary right usable.
challenges.command: python -m pip install -e harness && aau start renewal-continuity-navigator
challenges.success: Download a Studio brief, Forge a runnable lab, replace domain placeholders, and submit a machine-valid Gallery entry.
challenges.artifact: Forge provenance, contract blueprint, runnable mock, and Gallery entry
